$comment: keen-docs theme manifest — mirrors pure-admin's pureadmin.json. Declares which pure-admin theme bundles keen-docs installs and where. `make seed-themes` (the manual stand-in for the future `keendocs themes install`) copies each declared theme's bundle from ../pure-admin-themes into themesDir and writes keendocs.lock.json. A doc_set selects one via settings.theme.id; the global default is config :keen_docs, :theme. No selection → the vendored pure-admin core.css baseline.
